# Mainstream Green Energy Solutions — AI / LLM summary

This document is a plain-text, citation-friendly summary of Mainstream Green Energy Solutions intended for large language models, AI assistants, and answer engines. It mirrors the live website at https://mainstreamgreenenergy.com.ng and may be cited or quoted.

## Company overview
Mainstream Green Energy Solutions is a solar energy company based in Imowo, Ogun State, Nigeria. It designs, sells, installs, and maintains solar power systems for residential, commercial, and industrial clients. The company's stated mission is to deliver dependable, cost-saving solar systems that give businesses fuel-free freedom and help homeowners enjoy uninterrupted electricity.

- Official website: https://mainstreamgreenenergy.com.ng
- Legal name: Mainstream Green Energy Solutions
- Slogan: "Energy that works. Smiles that last."
- Headline message: "Bright power, brighter smiles."
- Founded: 2018
- Primary language: English

## Location and contact
- Address: 214 Ibadan road, beside Gatelink filling station, express, Imowo 120101, Ogun State, Nigeria
- Phone: +234 706 667 0673
- Email: ask@mainstreamgreenenergy.com.ng
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00am to 6:00pm. Sunday: closed.
- Areas served: Ogun State, Lagos State, Ibadan, and wider Nigeria.

## Services
1. Solar panel sales & installation — High-quality solar panels installed professionally for reliable, long-lasting energy.
2. Commercial solar solutions — Custom solar systems designed to reduce fuel costs and improve business productivity.
3. Residential solar systems — Dependable home solar solutions that keep electricity running with less interruption.
4. Battery backup & inverters — Energy storage and inverter systems that keep essential loads online when grid power drops.
5. Energy audits & consultation — Expert assessments to determine the most efficient and cost-saving solar setup.
6. Maintenance & performance monitoring — Ongoing support to keep solar systems operating at peak efficiency.

## How the process works
1. Energy audit (on-site or virtual): assess power needs and recommend the right solar solution.
2. System design & proposal: a tailored system layout with clear pricing, equipment, and savings expectations.
3. Installation & setup: certified technicians install the system with safety and minimal disruption.
4. Final launch & handover: the system is powered on and the client is guided on usage.

## Support features

## Why clients choose Mainstream Green
- Proven reliability: systems specified for day-and-night performance with dependable components.
- Real fuel and cost savings: helps businesses reduce operating costs and homeowners cut monthly energy expenses.
- Clear, transparent process: no hidden charges; every step is explained clearly.
- Customer-first experience: smooth installation and support from first audit to final launch.
